data.one_liner: A Flutter UI kit providing Senior Design System components for mobile apps.
data.what_it_does: It offers a collection of pre‑styled widgets such as buttons, modals, calendars, and more, following the Senior design guidelines. The package also includes a theme manager to apply consistent styling across the app.
use_when: You need a consistent design system across multiple Flutter apps
You want ready‑made, branded widgets without building them from scratch
avoid_when: You require a highly custom UI that deviates from the Senior design language
You need a lightweight solution with minimal dependencies
weaknesses: Ties you to Senior's visual language
Relies on many third‑party packages, increasing app size

alternatives.name: material_ui
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides a similar comprehensive set of Material‑styled widgets with a more generic look
